thread.title: Universal Display stock falls after Susquehanna cuts revenue forecast

author: Emily Bary
title: Universal Display stock falls after Susquehanna cuts revenue forecast
text: Shares of Universal Display Corp. OLED, -2.32% are down 2% in premarket trading Monday after Susquehanna analyst Mehdi Hosseini cut his calendar-year 2018 revenue estimates for the company due to his projection for about 20 million fewer OLED smartphone builds during the year. He said that "a few million" of those are attributable to Samsung and the rest of them are attributable to Apple Inc. AAPL, -0.33% "We recently noted Samsung's Galaxy S9 is not doing well, with the overall production forecast reduced to 35 million, down from prior 40 million," Hosseini wrote. "For Apple, we are now forecasting new iPhone production build of ~85 million in 2H18 vs. prior 100 million with OLED mix of ~52%." He said that there's upside potential in the fact that "the display size for new phones is larger." Universal Display stock fell on Friday after the Wall Street Journal reported that Apple would continue using LCD screens in its upcoming iPhone lineup. The stock has fallen 20% over the past 12 months, while the S&P 500 SPX, -0.56% has gained 14%.
